استطبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَطَبُّوا (istaṭabbū) /is.ta.tˤab.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَطَبَّ (istaṭabba)
# اِسْتَطِبُّوا (istaṭibbū) /is.ta.tˤib.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَطَبَّ (istaṭabba)
